posts.message: Sending Chickens next week let us know what you want before it’s final

Dinner’s working while we are. 🐷🍂

Tonight at the Roswell house, we’ve got a pork butt roast in the Crock-Pot with Roswell’s Pot Roast seasoning, onions, chopped garlic cloves, baby carrots and butter!

A little prep, then back to the day while dinner cooks. That’s our kind of family meal—and we’ll show you how it turns out tonight. 🍽️

Want to make your own? Head to our Pork Cuts Orders page and request a Butt Roast. We’ll confirm availability, your final total based on its actual weight, and pickup arrangements.

👉 https://roswellfamilyfarm.com/pork-cuts-orders.html

🐔 You’ve told us what interests you. Now we’ve got prices to go with it!

We’re planning these new chicken options with a USDA-inspected processor:

• Breaded chicken nuggets — $16 per 20 oz bag
• Ground chicken — $9.96 per 1 lb package
• Maple chicken sausage — $10.67 per 1 lb package, 5 links
• Chicken bone broth — $10 per quart, 32 fl oz

Some of you have already mentioned ground chicken and bone broth—thank you! Knowing what your household would purchase at these prices helps us decide what to produce and how much.

Tell us which products you’d buy, how many packages, and your town. Comment below or message us privately. We welcome feedback from across New York, whether you’ve followed us for years or just found our farm.

This is an interest check, not an order. Availability will be announced once confirmed.
